steps.text: Sift flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt into a large bowl; make a well in the center. Whisk together water and oil in a small bowl.
Pour oil and water into flour mixture.
Stir just until blended; mixture will be lumpy.
Heat a lightly oiled griddle over medium-high heat.
Drop batter by large spoonfuls onto the griddle. Cook until bubbles form and edges are dry. Flip, then cook until bottoms are browned, 1 to 2 minutes. Repeat with remaining batter.

raw_recipe.headline: Vegan Pancakes
raw_recipe.description: These vegan pancakes are light, fluffy, and delicious. The dairy-free batter is easy to make with pantry ingredients for perfect pancakes every time!

video.description: In this video, we show you how to make vegan pancakes. This eggless batter makes very light and fluffy pancakes using ingredients you probably have on hand. Get creative with your toppings: fresh berries, sliced bananas, toasted pecans, and more!

review.reviewBody: I tried this recipe this morning for my son and I and they were wonderful!! I especially loved the fact that the ingredients were things I already had in my pantry. No "fancy" ingredients that I would have to substitute. But, I did use 1 cup rice milk and 1/4 cup water instead of 1 1/4 cup water. I found that spreading the batter evenly with the back of a spoon really enabled the pancakes to cook evenly and not stay uncooked in the center. Wonderful recipe. And to the reviewer who stated that just because this was a good vegan subtitute for "normal pancakes" that it wasn't worth 5 stars, I would like to disagree. I don't think a regular buttermilk pancake is 5 star cuisine. I feel that vegan recipes are just just as good, if not better than "regular" food. They are much kinder to your health, the planet, and the animals who would have suffered for that buttermilk. I think this compares to the best. 5 stars.

I liked this recipe but I loved the concept! I never realized how good simple vegan pancakes could be! After making them a couple of times, I changed several things but just wanted to share to show how versatile the recipe is. I use 3/4 cup white flour and 1/2 cup whole wheat pastry flour, all unsweetened almond milk in place of water to add some calcium, unsweetened apple sauce in place of oil and added 1 tsp cinnamon and 1 tsp vanilla extract. I have never had any problem with them being gummy like some reviewers have stated. I think that may result from over mixing. Simply spreading the batter out with the back of a spoon ensures even baking. Although they are lighter than other pancakes I've made, if I turn the heat up a little on my cast iron skillet, they brown nicely. I serve with a blueberry syrup made with frozen blueberries, a splash of maple syrup and chia seeds to thicken slightly. Delicious!

Made this recipe and regular pancakes for a church breakfast. Everyone wanted these pancakes because they had a great flavor! I used Einkorn wheat flour, almond milk with vanilla (from Costco), and avocado oil. The pancakes were cooked using vegan butter. They were even better when we added some blueberries! They were a tad sweet, but that let me use less syrup and just have fresh fruit on top. Highly recommend this recipe!

I have made this recipe many times. I added a teaspoon of cinnamon to it. I have also made them using a cup of blueberries in the batter and my last experiment was mashing two ripe bananas into the recipe. (Excellent)

This recipe is so easy and on point! Simple ingredients and yet so fluffy with a mildly sweet taste. I added vegan chocolate chips on one batch and frozen blueberries on the other and it kicked it up a notch. Be sure to hand mix ss blender can make the pancakes rubbery due to increase in gluten. Thanks for this great find.
Added bananas (Oh Jack Johnson) to the dry ingredients, then mushed well, adjusted water accordingly. Crispy, fluffy cakes!

I didn't have baking powder, I substituted it with 1/4 tsp of baking soda and 1/2 tsp lemon juice (this ratio=1 tsp of baking powder). I have made this twice, 1st pancake doesn't come out good (this is on my end), but afterwards they taste like regular pancakes. 1st attempt also I substituted white sugar with agave syrup, 2nd attempt with stevia and I notice no difference between the two. In the long run, it doesn't matter because agave syrup goes on top ! Great recipe, cheaper to make than buying pancake mix

I looked in the comments and decided instead of adding 1 and 1/4 cup of water. I added one cup of oat milk(what I had on hand) and only 1/4 cup of water.
And they turned out great and impressed my non-vegan sister! I also added vegan chocolate chips.
I will defiantly make these again

These were really good! I tweaked it a bit though and added an extra two tablespoons of sugar, less salt, two teaspoons of vanilla essence, two tablespoons of cocoa powder, two crushed chocolate biscuits, no oil and took out a bit of the water and replaced it with soy milk ??

Easy and straight forward as it is and tastes delicious. No modifications needed. 

Having said this, I added about 1 cup of vegan chocolate chips for a nice surprise. 

Can also add a teaspoon of vanilla extract for slightly different (positive) flaovur.

This is an awesome recipe. I made it but used unsweetened Almond milk in place of the water and added 1/2 mashed banana and 1/4 cup of chopped walnuts! Very moist and tasty! Doesn’t even need syrup!!!! Yummy!

this was my first time making pancakes and they turned out delicious! i did add chocolate chips and a little vanilla extract, but that was the only deviation from the recipe other than my general lack of a sifter. overall really easy to make and i'm very happy with them
Very easy and fast! I added freeze-dried blueberries and a little vanilla extract.

We have been making these pancakes for years, and while not vegan, this recipe guarantees we have all the ingredients on hand! I do substitute butter for the oil sometimes, if we have it on hand (because we're not vegan and enjoy the flavor) and always add a splash or 2 of vanilla. This recipe lives on top of our microwave for the teens to reference whenever they feel like a little snack!

These surprised me with how good they were. Following other reviews I subbed the oil with applesauce, added a little cinnamon and cocoa powder then subbed soy milk instead of water for the protein and topped them with blackberries. This is my new go to “vegan” pancake recipe ❤️
love it, but it tastes more like dough but still really easy and worth the effort. I would advise to add a little bit less salt cause I tasted the salt.
Needs a timing when cooking i tried it at first it was raw then i cooked more now it was overcooked also it need more flavour like lemon juice or more sugar! Hope that helps!
These pancakes are quick and easy to make. They are very tasty and satisfying. Can easily top off with cinnamon or fruit for extra yummy pancakes.
I love this!!

This recipe is ok if you have nothing else. I wanted my pancakes to have that raised, fluffy look and I didn't see that in the photos from the baker. They say flax seed is a good egg replacer and I happen to have flax seed. I don't know if it's the reason for the success of my pancakes but I add ground flax seed in addition to this recipe (excluding the oil if using some in a pan). Just adding this to my ingredients It was a game changer. Per online, chia seeds are good to use as a egg replacer too if you don't have ground flax seed or are allergic to it. From what I got online 1 tbsp of ground flax seed to 3 tsbp of water and let sit in the refrigerator for 15 mins
